newsitem.title: USA: TCI to press programmers for savings.
newsitem.headline: TCI to press programmers for savings.

text.p: The head of Tele-Communications Inc's cable businesses said on Thursday the biggest U.S. cable-systems operator would press programmers for cost savings.

Brendan Clouston, chief executive of TCI Communications, said in a telephone conference his group was seeking cost savings on every front and wanted better terms from suppliers of cable channels for its 14 million U.S. customers.
He declined to detail talks and acknowledged the company already gets the best prices from programmers of any operator because of its size and purchasing power.
Leading programmers to cable include Time Warner Inc, Viacom and Walt Disney Co.

Operators hold the upper hand in bargaining because channel slots are generally limited, a condition illustrated by big media groups such as News Corp Ltd competing fiercely to secure carriage for all-news channels.
